bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, or by phone or email (reservations@newpunjabclub.com). Dinner has a minimum spend of HK$800 per person; for dinners later in the week it is taken as a deposit when booking, which is not refundable but counts towards the bill. Payment is cashless only.
cancellation: Cancellations within 48 hours cost HK$800 per person. Tables are held for 15 minutes; a party arriving later may lose its booking.
groups: Large parties can have the chefs' curated sharing menu. The whole restaurant can be hired for private events.
dressCode: Guests are encouraged to dress up. No sportswear or singlets, and for men no shorts or open-toed shoes.
children: Children aged 10 and over are welcome. Younger children only when the restaurant is hired for a private event.
duration: Tables are booked for two hours.
byob: Guests may bring their own: HK$500 per 750ml bottle of wine, HK$1,200 per 500ml bottle of Maotai or 700ml bottle of spirits, HK$1,800 per one-litre bottle of spirits.
